summary: Tested BloxGrade admin bank PIN-protected operations (RTP settings, pool +/-, bank adjust +/-, and new full bank reset). Backend: 13/13 pytest passed including PIN validation matrix (missing→422, wrong→403 'Неверный PIN-код', correct→200), factory reset semantics (bank/pool/commission/deposits_total/withdrawals_total/adjustments_total all == 0, not -0), ledger fully wiped with exactly one 'reset' row, Mongo bank_state has cleared receipt arrays and commission_backfill_version=1, games.total and rtp.wagered unchanged, and pool topup after reset is NOT back-filled from historical upgrades. Frontend: full happy-path + negative flow through UI works — pin dialog appears with 90% in description, wrong PIN keeps dialog open + shows error toast, correct PIN closes dialog and applies change; pool/adjust with PIN update stats; reset dialog shows red 'ВЕСЬ банк' title, cancel is a no-op, confirm zeroes all stats while games counter stays.
critical_code_review_comments: Task spec references seed input testids admin-seed-word-0..9 but the actual UI uses admin-seed-word-1..10 (see AdminPage.jsx L88 uses `i+1`). Test spec should be updated OR the component switched to 0-indexed, otherwise external test harnesses following the spec will fail.
server.py file is 2729 lines — exceeds 700 LOC guideline; consider splitting admin/bank routes into a router module.

admin_bank_reset drops db.bank_ledger.delete_many({}) inside only the in-process asyncio lock (_upgrade_lock) — no Mongo lease. Concurrent workers/replicas could interleave a spin ledger write between delete_many and the reset row insert. Consider using the same bank_lock() context used elsewhere.
